speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Left Lobe).

The clinical presentation of fever (implied by recent flu), purulent sputum, and pleuritic chest pain, combined with the inability to provide a definitive chest X-ray image, strongly supports this diagnosis. I will initiate empiric antibiotic therapy immediately while arranging a follow-up imaging study if symptoms do not improve within 48 hours.
